text: This solution, Earthquake Disaster Risk Indexing (EDRI) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in India between Government of India (GoI), Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM), Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), India Meteorological Department (IMD), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) India, Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT Roorkee, IIT Kanpur, IIT Bombay), and RMSI. The program was implemented in Cannot be determined and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
